description: This file defines classes and functions related to OAuth2 security schemes in FastAPI, including forms for password authentication, OAuth2 dependency classes for various OAuth2 flows (password, implicit, authorization code), and supporting utilities like OAuth2 scopes.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: Dependency class for collecting username and password via form data for OAuth2 password flow.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: Enhanced dependency class requiring explicit 'grant_type' field with value 'password' for strict OAuth2 password flow.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 security schemes, used as dependency; supports various OAuth2 flows.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: Class implementing OAuth2 password flow for bearer token authentication.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: Class implementing OAuth2 authorization code flow for bearer token authentication.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: Helper class to aggregate OAuth2 scopes required by dependencies.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 error with WWW-Authenticate header for authentication failures.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Retrieve authorization info from the request headers, processing OAuth2 authorization schemes.

                " ), ] = None, auto_error: Annotated[ bool, Doc( "
                By default, if no HTTP Authorization header is provided, required for
                OAuth2 authentication, it will automatically cancel the request and
                send the client an error.

                If `auto_error` is set to `False`, when the HTTP Authorization header
                is not available, instead of erroring out, the dependency result will
                be `None`.

                This is useful when you want to have optional authentication.

                provided in one of multiple optional ways (for example, with OAuth2
                or in a cookie).

__init__( self, *, grant_type: Annotated[ Union[str, None], Form(pattern="^password$"), Doc( "
                The OAuth2 spec says it is required and MUST be the fixed string
                "password". Nevertheless, this dependency class is permissive and

                A single string with actually several scopes separated by spaces. Each
                scope is also a string.

                For example, a single string with:

                ```python

                ````

                would represent the scopes:

                * `profile`
                * `openid`
                " ), ] = "", client_id: Annotated[ Union[str, None], Form(), Doc( "
